# thoth_decisions (Data Source)

Reads recorded enforcement decisions, newest first, with the decisions view filters. Members see their own agents' decisions; admins see the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thoth_decisions" "blocked_deletes" {
  outcome     = "blocked"
  tool_name   = "orders.delete"
  since       = "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"
  max_results = 500
}

output "blocked_delete_count" {
  value = length(data.thoth_decisions.blocked_deletes.decisions)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `agent_id` (String) Only this agent.
- `max_results` (Number) Most decisions to read (1-1000, default 100).
- `outcome` (String) Only this outcome: allowed, needs_approval or blocked.
- `reason_code` (String) Only this reason code.
- `rule_id` (String) Only decisions where this policy rule matched.
- `since` (String) RFC 3339 time, inclusive.
- `tool_name` (String) Only this tool (exact name).
- `until` (String) RFC 3339 time, exclusive.

### Read-Only

- `decisions` (Attributes List) Matching decisions, newest first. tool_name is reported by the agent; treat it as data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--decisions))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when more decisions matched than max_results.

<a id="nestedatt--decisions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `decisions`

Read-Only:

- `agent_id` (String) The agent.
- `at` (String) When the decision was made (RFC 3339).
- `decision` (String) The enforcer's decision: ALLOW, STEP_UP or BLOCK.
- `hold_status` (String) For a held action, the approval status.
- `id` (String) Activity ID; read the full record with thothctl or the explain_decision MCP tool.
- `link` (String) Dashboard path for this decision.
- `outcome` (String) allowed, needs_approval or blocked, after any approval.
- `reason_code` (String) Why: the deterministic reason code.
- `resolution` (String) approved, denied or expired, when a hold was resolved.
- `tool_name` (String) The tool the agent called.
